text:
kai: Quick idea — adding a live per-route quota preview inside the Role Editor. Show tokens/min and burst implications for each selected scope.

marta: +1 on visibility. Admins always ask "what does this actually mean for my routes".

sam: curious — is this just a UI calc or tied to the quota service?

kai: UI calc initially. We compute effective throughput from role scopes + quota caps using our current quota model. Not gating enforcement, just preview. :eyes:

jin: small concern: previews might be misleading if routing policies (cost-based fallback / multi-model routing) change at runtime. Need a disclaimer.

kai: agreed — plan to add "estimated" badge and include the routing policy snapshot used for the calc. Short text: "Estimate uses active routing policy: region-first, cost-fallback v2"

leigh: UX nit — show per-route rows with: route name, allowed model variants, estimated qps, estimated tokens/min. Collapse long lists.

marta: could we show a sample request that would be allowed/denied? makes it tangible. e.g., example prompt size -> estimated tokens consumed.

kai: good idea. We can synthesize a tiny sample: 1 short prompt, 1 long prompt, and show whether quota would block.

sam: implementationally, watch perf — computing estimates for every role change could be expensive if we simulate many routes. Maybe compute on-demand or debounce.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: role-editor-preview feature flag rollout at 2026-04-01T15:00Z.

jin: also add telemetry ping when admins open the preview so we can track confusion points. event: role_preview.open with route_count and routing_policy_id.

leigh: for enterprise customers, we should hide internal model names and show only profiles e.g., "low-cost replica" -> avoid leaking model metadata.

kai: noted. We'll map variants to public labels for private tenants.

marta: question about permissions: who can see the preview? current thought: same as role editor access. But maybe a lower bar — support folks might need read-only preview without edit permission.

sam: yeah, add a "preview-only" capability on entitlements. Should be a boolean on role: allow_role_preview.

jin: API shape suggestion — add GET /roles/:id/preview?routing_policy=... returns a tiny JSON with per-route estimates. Keep it read-only.

kai: pseudo snippet for UI call:
```
GET /api/internal/roles/123/preview?routing_policy=region-first
Response: { routes: [{name: "/v1/generate", est_tpm: 1200, est_qps: 20, sample_blocked: false}], routing_policy_id: "rp_42" }
```

marta: looks good. Let's also add an audit log entry when someone views a preview for enterprise tenants.

kai: summary action items: 1) Add preview endpoint (jin) 2) UI cards + sample requests (leigh) 3) add telemetry + audit hooks (marta + jin) 4) feature flag + rollout plan (sam). I'll create the ticket.

sam: debounce on the UI calc and rate-limit preview API — no heavy sim churn.

leigh: I'll mock screens this afternoon and post in #design.

kai: thanks team — keeping this lightweight. We'll avoid hard guarantees in wording. :thumbsup:
